projects.title: Contact Index
bullets: Compared alternative data structures for the recorded contact index operations as a contribution to a team course project.
Implemented linked structures and traversal operations in Java for the team's contact index project, using Git.

projects.title: Course Planner
bullets: Implemented a menu-driven course planner in Java using functions and collections as a contribution to a team course project.
Tested representative inputs, recorded expected outputs, and documented how course planner records are added, searched, and updated.

projects.title: Course Prerequisite Graph
bullets: Tested connected, disconnected, and cyclic examples for an individual course prerequisite graph project using Java and Git.
Explained algorithm choices and computational complexity for the course prerequisite graph in the individual course project.
